## Headline: when is router-guided prefetch worth anything?

(Auto-derived exit-criteria statement, Experiments.md E1: *"You can state, in one sentence with numbers, the condition under which router-guided prefetch is worth anything."*)

- **mixtral_fp16**: mixtral (fp16): NOT reachable anywhere in the swept grid (batch<=64, residency<=75%, link<=128 GB/s) -- even at the most favorable point tested this regime needs ~136 GB/s to hit rho=1. Byte reduction (E7 precision-gating), not prefetch alone, is required here.
- **mixtral_nf4**: mixtral (nf4): router-guided prefetch is worth something (rho<1) once residency >= 75% on a >=64 GB/s link at batch >= 1 (expert ~90.9 MB, t_compute source: measured_here).
- **olmoe_fp16**: olmoe (fp16): router-guided prefetch is worth something (rho<1) once residency >= 75% on a >=16 GB/s link at batch >= 1 (expert ~12.6 MB, t_compute source: measured_here).
- **olmoe_nf4**: olmoe (nf4): router-guided prefetch is worth something (rho<1) once residency >= 0% on a >=16 GB/s link at batch >= 1 (expert ~3.2 MB, t_compute source: measured_here).
